---
title: "R code to generate Change from baseline across timepoints plot"
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseC: NA
    func_C: NA
    final_tC: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    x_lab: "Timepoint"
    y_lab: "Mean change from baseline across timepoints (with 95% CI) \n in PRO domain"
    improveC: "Improvement"
    worseC: "Worsening"
    impTextC: 17 
    worTextC: -17 
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer"))

library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Set the parameters
continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseC <- params$no_doseC
func_C <- params$func_C
final_tC <- params$final_tC
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date

# Filter to leave only the relevant PRO domain and then remove the column
if (params$continuous_date == TRUE) {
    # continuous_data_filtered$timepoint == as.Date(continuous_data_filtered$timepoint)
    continuous_data_filtered <- date_to_timepoint_continuous(continuous_data)
}
continuous_data_filtered <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(functioning == func_C) %>%
    dplyr::select(-functioning)


# Find the baseline then calculate the change from baseline
diffC <- continuous_data_filtered %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(baseline = score[timepoint == min(timepoint)], adjusted_value = score - baseline) %>%
    ungroup()

# Find the mean and 95% CI for each dose at each timepoint then filter to relevant timepoints and doses
summaryC <- diffC %>%
    group_by(dose, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(adjusted_value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(adjusted_value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "keep")
summaryC <- summaryC %>%
    mutate(l.ci = mean - (1.96 * sd)) %>%
    mutate(u.ci = mean + (1.96 * sd))
summaryC <- summaryC %>%
    filter(timepoint <= final_tC) %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseC)

# Set up plot parameters
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.2)

impbound <- params$improveC
worbound <- params$worseC
upper <- max(impbound[2], worbound[2], max(diffC$adjusted_value))
lower <- min(impbound[1], worbound[1], min(diffC$adjusted_value))

worse_text <- if (worbound[1] < impbound[1]) {
    min(max(params$worTextC, worbound[1]), worbound[2])
} else {
    max(min(params$worTextC, worbound[2]), worbound[1])
}

improve_text <- if (worbound[1] < impbound[1]) {
    max(min(params$impTextC, impbound[2]), impbound[1])
} else {
    min(max(params$impTextC, impbound[1]), impbound[2])
}

# Generate the plot
summaryC %>% ggplot(
    aes(
        x = as.factor(timepoint),
        y = mean, group = as.factor(dose), shape = as.factor(dose), colour = as.factor(dose)
    )
) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = impbound[1], ymax = impbound[2], fill = "palegreen1"), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = worbound[1], ymax = worbound[2], fill = "red"), alpha = 0.1, colour = NA) +
    geom_point(position = pd, size = 3) +
    geom_line(size = 1.5) +
    geom_errorbar(position = pd, aes(ymin = l.ci, ymax = u.ci), width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    guides(
        shape = guide_legend(title = "Dose"),
        colour = guide_legend(title = "Dose")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    xlab(params$x_lab) +
    ylab(paste0(params$y_lab)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Threshold", values = c("palegreen1", "red"), label = c("Improvement", "Worsening")) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0.8, xend = 0.8, y = 0, yend = max(impbound[2], worbound[2])),
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        )
    ) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0.8, xend = 0.8, y = 0, yend = min(impbound[1], worbound[1])),
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        )
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = data.frame(x = 1.6, y = params$impTextC, label = "Improvement"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = data.frame(x = 1.6, y = params$worTextC, label = "Worsening"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggtitle(params$title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize)) +
    ylim(lower, upper)
```
